messages.subject: Calling navbarPage from renderUI failing.
parts:

output$page <- renderUI({
  
    div(class="outer",
        tags$head(includeCSS("www/css/app.css")),
        do.call(navbarPage, c(title = "Clinical Information Network",ui())))
   
})
